title: Tile rect from a cell
prompt: Tiles are 64 by 64 pixels. Return the Rect2 that covers the tile at the given column and row.
starter:
func solve(column, row) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2()
hints: Position is the cell scaled by 64; size is always 64 by 64.

docs.name: Rect2(x, y, width, height)
docs.what: Makes a rectangle from a top-left corner and a size. Also Rect2(position, size) with two vectors.

docs.name: Vector2(x, y)
docs.what: Makes a vector holding an x and a y. Read them back with .x and .y.

solution:
func solve(column, row) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(Vector2(column, row) * 64, Vector2(64, 64))
